1:s1.en: In the name of God, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate.
1:s1.tr: Rahmân ve Rahîm olan Allah'ın adıyla.

1:s2.en: Praise belongs to God, Lord of the worlds, and blessing and peace upon the best of creation, and upon his family and all his companions.
1:s2.tr: Hamd âlemlerin Rabbi Allah'a; salât ve selâm yaratılmışların en hayırlısına, âline ve bütün ashâbına olsun.

1:s3.en: To proceed — may God make you happy in both abodes — the paths to God Most High are as many as the breaths of created beings.
1:s3.tr: İmdi — Allah seni iki cihanda mesut etsin — Allah Teâlâ'ya giden yollar, mahlûkâtın nefesleri sayısıncadır.

1:s4.en: The masters of realisation chose from among them one path in which there are four ranks: the first is the Shari'a, the second the Tariqa, the third Ma'rifa, and the fourth Haqiqa.
1:s4.tr: Tahkîk ehli bunlardan içinde dört mertebe bulunan bir yol seçmiştir: birincisi şerîat, ikincisi tarîkat, üçüncüsü ma'rifet, dördüncüsü hakîkattir.

1:s5.en: And none of those ranks is complete except through the Shari'a.
1:s5.tr: Bu mertebelerin hepsi ancak şerîatle tamam olur.

1:s6.en: For whoever's Shari'a is not perfected, the Tariqa, Ma'rifa and Haqiqa are not attained by him.
1:s6.tr: Çünkü şerîatı kâmil olmayan kimseye tarîkat, ma'rifet ve hakîkat hâsıl olmaz.

1:s7.en: And whoever corrupts the Shari'a after completing the ranks has corrupted the Tariqa, Ma'rifa and Haqiqa.
1:s7.tr: Mertebeleri tamamladıktan sonra şerîatı bozan kimse tarîkatı, ma'rifeti ve hakîkati de bozmuş olur.

1:s8.en: As the Prophet, God bless him and grant him peace, said: the Shari'a is a tree, the Tariqa its branches, Ma'rifa its leaves and Haqiqa its fruits; if there is no tree, there are neither its branches nor its leaves nor its fruits.
1:s8.tr: Nitekim Peygamber sallallâhu aleyhi ve sellem buyurdu: Şerîat bir ağaçtır, tarîkat onun dalları, ma'rifet yaprakları, hakîkat meyveleridir; ağaç olmayınca ne dalları, ne yaprakları, ne de meyveleri olur.

1:s9.en: By this it is known that the Shari'a is the root and the rest are branches, and the existence of the branch comes through the existence of the root.
1:s9.tr: Bununla bilinir ki şerîat asıl, diğerleri fer'dir; fer'in varlığı aslın varlığıyladır.

1:s10.en: So when the root is gone, the branch is gone.
1:s10.tr: Asıl yok olunca fer' de yok olur.

1:s11.en: This is an indication that the servant does not step outside the Shari'a in any of the ranks.
1:s11.tr: Bu, kulun hiçbir mertebede şerîatın dışına çıkmayacağına işarettir.

1:s12.en: So if he steps beyond the bounds of the Shari'a and thinks himself on a straight path, he is among the losers, the perishing, the heretics.
1:s12.tr: Şerîatın sınırından çıkıp da kendini doğru yolda sanırsa, hüsrana uğrayan, helâk olan ve mülhid olanlardan olur.

1:s13.en: He becomes astray and leading astray; so he is not among the winners who arrive, but among the followers of the devils.
1:s13.tr: Hem sapmış hem saptıran olur; kazanıp vâsıl olanlardan değil, şeytanların tâbilerinden olur.

1:s14.en: As in His saying, Most High: "that is the manifest loss."
1:s14.tr: Allah Teâlâ'nın şu sözü gibi: "İşte apaçık hüsran budur."

1:s15.en: Those four ranks are forty stations.

1:s16.en: For the servant does not reach God Most High except by traversing those stations.
1:s16.tr: Çünkü kul Allah Teâlâ'ya ancak bu makāmları kat ederek ulaşır.

1:s17.en: Ten of them are in the Shari'a, ten in the Tariqa, ten in Ma'rifa and ten in Haqiqa.
1:s17.tr: Bunların onu şerîatte, onu tarîkatte, onu ma'rifette ve onu hakîkattedir.

2:s1.en: As for the stations that are in the Shari'a:

2:s2.en: The first of them is faith, by his saying, peace be upon him: faith is that you believe in God, His angels, His books, His messengers, the Last Day, and in the decree, its good and its evil being from God Most High.
2:s2.tr: Birincisi îmandır; Peygamber aleyhisselâmın şu sözüyle: Îman, Allah'a, meleklerine, kitaplarına, peygamberlerine, âhiret gününe ve hayrı ile şerri Allah Teâlâ'dan olmak üzere kadere inanmandır.

2:s3.en: If it is asked: is faith in the body or in the spirit?
2:s3.tr: Eğer denilse: Îman bedende midir, ruhta mı?

2:s4.en: We say: it is in the intellect.

2:s5.en: The masters of realisation said: faith is affirmation by the tongue and assent by the heart.
2:s5.tr: Tahkîk ehli dedi ki: Îman dil ile ikrar, kalp ile tasdiktir.

2:s6.en: For whoever does not affirm the oneness of God Most High with the tongue is an outright unbeliever.
2:s6.tr: Çünkü Allah Teâlâ'nın birliğini dil ile ikrar etmeyen mutlak kâfirdir.

2:s7.en: Likewise, if he affirmed with the tongue but did not assent with the heart, he is a hypocrite.
2:s7.tr: Aynı şekilde, dil ile ikrar edip kalp ile tasdik etmezse münâfıktır.

2:s8.en: So he will be in the lowest depth of the Fire.
2:s8.tr: O da cehennemin en aşağı tabakasında olur.

2:s9.en: We only said "faith is in the intellect" because the intellect is a sultan in the body and faith is his deputy.
2:s9.tr: "Îman akıldadır" dememizin sebebi şudur: Akıl bedende sultandır, îman onun vekilidir.

2:s10.en: If the sultan goes, his deputy does not remain.

2:s11.en: For example: faith is a treasury, Iblis a thief and the intellect a treasurer; if the treasurer goes, the thief steals what is in the treasury.
2:s11.tr: Meselâ: Îman bir hazine, İblis bir hırsız, akıl ise hazinedârdır; hazinedâr giderse hırsız hazinedekini çalar.

2:s12.en: It was said: faith is a sheep, the intellect a shepherd and Iblis a wolf; if the shepherd goes, the wolf eats it.
2:s12.tr: Denildi ki: Îman bir koyun, akıl bir çoban, İblis bir kurttur; çoban giderse kurt onu yer.

2:s13.en: And it was said: faith is milk, the intellect a guard and Iblis a dog, and they are in one place.
2:s13.tr: Ve denildi ki: Îman süt, akıl bekçi, İblis köpektir; hepsi bir yerdedir.

2:s14.en: So when the guard goes, the dog eats it.

2:s15.en: In this is a fine point: that assent to the oneness of God Most High is obeying His commands and avoiding His prohibitions.
2:s15.tr: Bunda ince bir nükte vardır: Allah Teâlâ'nın birliğini tasdik, O'nun emirlerine uymak ve yasaklarından kaçınmaktır.

2:s16.en: And assent that God Most High has appointed over every child of Adam three hundred angels is part of faith.
2:s16.tr: Allah Teâlâ'nın her Âdemoğlunun üzerine üç yüz melek görevlendirdiğini tasdik de îmandandır.

2:s17.en: For when someone of your own kind is with you, you feel shame before him to do a shameful deed.
2:s17.tr: Çünkü yanında kendi cinsinden biri olunca ondan utanır, çirkin bir iş yapmazsın.

2:s18.en: But when he is not of your kind you go ahead and feel no shame before the angels; so where is your assent to them?
2:s18.tr: Senin cinsinden olmayınca ise yapar, meleklerden utanmazsın; öyleyse onları tasdikin nerede?

2:s19.en: Assent to the Book of God Most High is part of faith, and what is in it of commands and prohibitions is true.
2:s19.tr: Allah Teâlâ'nın kitabını tasdik îmandandır; ondaki emirler ve yasaklar haktır.

2:s20.en: Yet you read it and do not act on the commands in it, nor avoid the prohibitions, nor fear the punishment of God Most High and His chastisement for not obeying and not avoiding.
2:s20.tr: Sen onu okursun da içindeki emirleri yapmaz, yasaklarından kaçınmaz, itaat etmemek ve kaçınmamak yüzünden Allah Teâlâ'nın azabından ve cezasından korkmazsın.

2:s21.en: And your heart is full of pride, envy, greed, anger, backbiting, guffawing, slander and mockery.
2:s21.tr: Kalbin ise kibir, hased, tamah, öfke, gıybet, kahkaha, koğuculuk ve alay ile doludur.

2:s22.en: These are among the prohibitions in the Book of God.

2:s23.en: So where is your assent to them?

2:s24.en: And where is the assent that the friends of God and their miracles are true?
2:s24.tr: Allah'ın velîlerinin ve kerâmetlerinin hak olduğunu tasdik nerede?

2:s25.en: If their miracles and their deeds conform to the Law without any claim, that is part of faith.
2:s25.tr: Kerâmetleri ve fiilleri iddiasız olarak şer'e uygunsa, bu îmandandır.

2:s26.en: For they gave up the pleasure of their own selves, the love of this world and delight in food and clothing; they chose the pleasure of their Lord, poverty, trial, hardship, hunger and lowliness; they gave up sleep and rest and found the hardship of this world an ease for the next, as in His saying, Most High: "indeed with hardship comes ease."
2:s26.tr: Çünkü onlar nefislerinin hoşnutluğunu, dünya sevgisini, yemek ve giyimden zevk almayı terk ettiler; Rablerinin rızâsını, fakrı, mihneti, meşakkati, açlığı ve miskinliği seçtiler; uykuyu ve rahatı bıraktılar; dünyanın zorluğunu âhiret için kolaylık bildiler — Allah Teâlâ'nın "Şüphesiz zorlukla beraber bir kolaylık vardır" sözü gibi.

2:s27.en: They live a day and go hungry two days.
2:s27.tr: Bir gün yer, iki gün aç kalırlar.

2:s28.en: As the Prophet, God bless him and grant him peace, said: I eat my fill one day and go hungry two.
2:s28.tr: Nitekim Peygamber sallallâhu aleyhi ve sellem buyurdu: Bir gün doyar, iki gün aç kalırım.

2:s29.en: Yet the nearer they draw to God Most High, the more He increases them in humility and fear of their Lord.
2:s29.tr: Fakat onlar Allah Teâlâ'ya yaklaştıkça Rablerinden huşû ve korkuları artar.

2:s30.en: For whoever draws near to one of the kings and sultans, his fear of him is greater than that of the other subjects.
2:s30.tr: Çünkü hükümdarlardan ve sultanlardan birine yaklaşan kimsenin ondan korkusu, diğer tebaanınkinden daha şiddetli olur.

2:s31.en: God looks at their faults with full sight and does not strike their faces with them — while you do every day all kinds of sins and foul deeds.
2:s31.tr: Allah onların hatâlarına tam bir nazarla bakar da bunları yüzlerine vurmaz; sen ise her gün türlü hatâlar ve çirkinlikler işlersin.

2:s32.en: Do you think you will not be called to account and not be questioned?
2:s32.tr: Hesaba çekilmeyeceğini ve sorgulanmayacağını mı sanıyorsun?

2:s33.en: And that the Hour will not come, that those in the graves will not be raised, and the happy not be told from the wretched?
2:s33.tr: Kıyâmetin kopmayacağını, kabirdekilerin diriltilmeyeceğini, saîdin şakîden ayrılmayacağını mı?

2:s34.en: And you do not guard against the unlawful.

2:s35.en: You eat and wear whatever you find, you eat your Lord's bounty, yet you do not obey His commands nor avoid His prohibitions.
2:s35.tr: Bulduğunu yer ve giyersin, Rabbinin nimetini yersin de emirlerine uymaz, yasaklarından kaçınmazsın.

2:s36.en: Will you not fear the wrath of God Most High and the consequence of the act of disobedience that brings loss?
2:s36.tr: Allah Teâlâ'nın gazabından ve hüsran getiren isyan fiilinin âkıbetinden korkmaz mısın?

2:s37.en: What then of the All-Knowing King? He says: I am God, the Generous, the Forgiving, the Giver, the Helper, the One whose help is sought; every day I look at a hundred thousand sins that come from My servant, yet I do not strike his face with them, and I am patient until he repents.
2:s37.tr: Ya her şeyi bilen Melik? O şöyle buyurur: Ben Kerîm, Gafûr, Mu'tî, Muîn ve Müsteân olan Allah'ım; her gün kulumdan çıkan yüz bin günaha bakarım da bunları yüzüne vurmam, tevbe edinceye kadar sabrederim.

2:s38.en: If he dies without repenting, his affair is in His hand.
2:s38.tr: Tevbe etmeden ölürse işi O'nun elindedir.

2:s39.en: If My will and My wish are to forgive him, I forgive him and have mercy on him; if not, I put him into the Fire and punish him with a painful punishment.
2:s39.tr: Meşîetim ve irâdem onu bağışlamaya yönelikse bağışlar ve merhamet ederim; değilse onu ateşe sokar, acı bir azapla azap ederim.

2:s40.en: But whoever wanted Me and loved Me, spent his life in My service, wept over separation from Me and sought union with Me — I want him and love him and do good to him, I free him from separation and bring him to Me, until identity is attained for him and nearness grows for him, so that he erases his own existence and sees Me in all things, none but Me.
2:s40.tr: Ama beni isteyen, beni seven, ömrünü hizmetime harcayan, ayrılığıma ağlayan ve vuslatımı dileyen kimseye gelince: Ben de onu ister, severim, ona ihsan ederim; onu ayrılıktan kurtarır, kendime ulaştırırım; tâ ki ona hüviyet hâsıl olsun, yakınlığı artsın; varlığını silsin ve her şeyde beni görsün, benden başkasını değil.

2:s41.en: But if his wish was for this world, I make him deprived of this world and the next, and he is among the sinners, the losers.
2:s41.tr: Eğer irâdesi dünyaya yönelikse onu dünyadan da âhiretten de mahrum ederim; o günahkârlardan ve hüsrana uğrayanlardan olur.

2:s42.en: As God Most High said: "Whoever desires the harvest of the Hereafter, We increase him in his harvest; and whoever desires the harvest of this world, We give him of it, and he has no share in the Hereafter."
2:s42.tr: Nitekim Allah Teâlâ buyurdu: "Kim âhiret ekinini isterse onun ekinini artırırız; kim dünya ekinini isterse ona ondan veririz, âhirette ise onun bir nasibi yoktur."

2:s43.en: And the Prophet, God bless him and grant him peace, said: this world is forbidden to the people of the Hereafter, the Hereafter is forbidden to the people of this world, and both are forbidden to the people of God Most High.
2:s43.tr: Peygamber sallallâhu aleyhi ve sellem de buyurdu: Dünya âhiret ehline haramdır, âhiret dünya ehline haramdır; ikisi de Allah Teâlâ'nın ehline haramdır.

3:s1.en: The second of the ten stations in the Shari'a is Islam.

3:s2.en: It is to bear witness that there is no god but God and that Muhammad is the Messenger of God, to establish the five prayers, to give the alms if due, to fast Ramadan and to make the pilgrimage to the House if one is able to find a way to it.
3:s2.tr: O da Allah'tan başka ilâh olmadığına ve Muhammed'in Allah'ın elçisi olduğuna şahitlik etmek, beş vakit namazı kılmak, vâcip olduğunda zekâtı vermek, Ramazan orucunu tutmak ve yoluna gücü yetenin Beyt'i haccetmesidir.

3:s3.en: It is an obligation whose performance is binding on every Muslim who is sane, of age and charged by the command of God Most High.
3:s3.tr: Bu, Allah Teâlâ'nın emriyle mükellef olan âkıl, bâliğ her müslümana edâsı lâzım bir farzdır.

3:s4.en: By His saying — exalted be His name: "Establish the prayer and give the alms."
3:s4.tr: İsmi yüce olanın şu sözüyle: "Namazı kılın ve zekâtı verin."

3:s5.en: And by his saying, peace be upon him: fast the month of Ramadan and make the pilgrimage to the House.
3:s5.tr: Ve Peygamber aleyhisselâmın şu sözüyle: Ramazan ayında oruç tutun ve Beyt'i haccedin.

3:s6.en: The third of them is knowledge, because action without knowledge is error and knowledge without action is a burden.
3:s6.tr: Üçüncüsü ilimdir; çünkü ilimsiz amel dalâlet, amelsiz ilim vebâldir.

3:s7.en: For seeking knowledge is an obligation on every Muslim man and woman, by His saying, Most High: "be people of the Lord."
3:s7.tr: Çünkü ilim talebi her müslüman erkek ve kadına farzdır; Allah Teâlâ'nın "Rabbânîler olun" sözüyle.

3:s8.en: The fourth of them is ihsan: that you worship God Most High with sincerity, humility, submissiveness and observance of the proper manners.
3:s8.tr: Dördüncüsü ihsandır: Allah Teâlâ'ya ihlâs, huşû, hudû ve âdâba riâyetle ibadet etmendir.

3:s9.en: As the Prophet, peace be upon him, said: ihsan is that you worship God as if you see Him; and if you do not see Him, He sees you.
3:s9.tr: Nitekim Peygamber aleyhisselâm buyurdu: İhsan, Allah'a O'nu görüyormuşsun gibi ibadet etmendir; sen O'nu görmüyorsan da O seni görür.

4:s1.en: The fifth of them is marriage, because it is an obligation by His saying, Most High: "marry such women as please you."
4:s1.tr: Beşincisi evliliktir; çünkü Allah Teâlâ'nın "Hoşunuza giden kadınlarla evlenin" sözüyle farzdır.

4:s2.en: And it is a sunna by his saying, peace be upon him: marriage is my sunna, and whoever turns away from my sunna is not of me.
4:s2.tr: Ve Peygamber aleyhisselâmın şu sözüyle sünnettir: Nikâh benim sünnetimdir; sünnetimden yüz çeviren benden değildir.

4:s3.en: The sixth of them is eating what is lawful and wearing what is lawful, by His saying, Most High: "eat of the good things We have provided you."
4:s3.tr: Altıncısı helâl yemek ve helâl giymektir; Allah Teâlâ'nın "Size verdiğimiz rızıkların temizlerinden yiyin" sözüyle.

4:s4.en: And by His saying, Most High: "and purify your garments."

4:s5.en: The seventh of them is that the servant be of the people of the Sunna and the community and not of the people of innovation, by His saying, Most High: "the way of God which has passed before, and you will never find any change in the way of God."
4:s5.tr: Yedincisi kulun Ehl-i sünnet ve'l-cemâatten olması, bid'at ehlinden olmamasıdır; Allah Teâlâ'nın "Allah'ın öteden beri süregelen kanunu budur; Allah'ın kanununda asla bir değişiklik bulamazsın" sözüyle.

5:s1.en: The eighth of them is compassion and mercy, by his saying, peace be upon him: have mercy on those on earth, and He who is in heaven will have mercy on you.
5:s1.tr: Sekizincisi şefkat ve merhamettir; Peygamber aleyhisselâmın şu sözüyle: Yerdekilere merhamet edin ki göktekiler size merhamet etsin.

5:s2.en: The ninth of them is earning what is lawful and holding the unlawful forbidden, by His saying, Most High: "God has permitted trade and forbidden usury."
5:s2.tr: Dokuzuncusu helâl kazanmak ve haramı haram bilmektir; Allah Teâlâ'nın "Allah alışverişi helâl, ribâyı haram kıldı" sözüyle.

5:s3.en: The tenth of them is enjoining the right and forbidding the wrong, because it is an obligation by His saying, Most High: "enjoin the right and forbid the wrong."
5:s3.tr: Onuncusu iyiliği emredip kötülükten alıkoymaktır; çünkü Allah Teâlâ'nın "İyiliği emret, kötülükten alıkoy" sözüyle farzdır.

5:s4.en: By the noble verses and the noble hadiths these ten stations that are in the Shari'a are established.
5:s4.tr: Kerîm âyetler ve şerîf hadislerle şerîatteki bu on makām sâbit olmuştur.

6:s1.en: As for the ten stations that are in the Tariqa:

6:s2.en: The first of them is to walk the way of the poor (the dervishes), to take the hand of the shaykhs, and repentance from sins, by His saying, Most High: "hold fast, all of you, to the rope of God."
6:s2.tr: Birincisi fakirlerin yoluna sülûk etmek, şeyhlerden el almak ve günahlardan tevbe etmektir; Allah Teâlâ'nın "Hep birlikte Allah'ın ipine sarılın" sözüyle.

6:s3.en: And His saying, Most High: "turn to God in sincere repentance."
6:s3.tr: Ve Allah Teâlâ'nın "Allah'a hâlis bir tevbe ile tevbe edin" sözüyle.

6:s4.en: For when the servant returns to God Most High, regrets the disobedience he committed and repents with the intention of not sinning after it, God forgives him what went before of his sin, by His saying, Most High: "so God turns to him; He is the Ever-Returning, the Merciful."
6:s4.tr: Çünkü kul Allah Teâlâ'ya dönüp işlediği günaha pişman olur ve bir daha günah işlememeye niyetle tevbe ederse, Allah onun geçmiş günahını bağışlar; Allah Teâlâ'nın "Allah onun tevbesini kabul eder; şüphesiz O Tevvâb ve Rahîm'dir" sözüyle.

6:s5.en: The Prophet, God bless him and grant him peace, said: one who repents of a sin is like one who has no sin.
6:s5.tr: Peygamber sallallâhu aleyhi ve sellem buyurdu: Günahtan tevbe eden, günahı olmayan gibidir.

6:s6.en: What is meant by repentance is sincere regret and making excuse before the Creator, exalted be His name.
6:s6.tr: Tevbeden maksat ihlâsla pişmanlık ve ismi yüce olan Bârî'nin huzurunda özür dilemektir.

6:s7.en: If he regrets his disobedience and makes his excuse to Him, Most High,
6:s7.tr: Günahına pişman olup O'na, Teâlâ'ya, özrünü arz ederse,

6:s8.en: sincerely, from the heart, then God Most High pardons him, through one excuse and one regret, the sins of seventy years.
6:s8.tr: ihlâsla, gönülden — Allah Teâlâ bir özür ve bir pişmanlıkla onun yetmiş yıllık günahlarını affeder.

6:s9.en: For sincere excuse and truthful reliance whiten one's being on the Day of Resurrection.
6:s9.tr: Çünkü ihlâsla özür ve sıdk ile tevekkül, kıyâmet günü varlığı ağartır.

6:s10.en: For God Most High says: O My servants, excuse and reliance with sincerity are from you, and acceptance is from Me — as in His saying, Most High: "whoever relies on God, He suffices him."
6:s10.tr: Çünkü Allah Teâlâ buyurur: Ey kullarım, ihlâsla özür ve tevekkül sizden, kabul bendendir — Allah Teâlâ'nın "Kim Allah'a tevekkül ederse O ona yeter" sözü gibi.

6:s11.en: Thanks is from you and increase is from Me, as in His saying, Most High: "if you give thanks I will surely increase you, and if you are ungrateful, My punishment is severe."
6:s11.tr: Şükür sizden, ziyade bendendir — Allah Teâlâ'nın "Şükrederseniz elbette sizi artırırım; nankörlük ederseniz azabım çok şiddetlidir" sözündeki gibi.

6:s12.en: Patience is from you and the giving of full reward without reckoning is from Me, by His saying, Most High: "the patient will be given their reward without reckoning."
6:s12.tr: Sabır sizden, hesapsız karşılık vermek bendendir; Allah Teâlâ'nın "Sabredenlere mükâfatları hesapsız ödenir" sözüyle.

6:s13.en: Obedience and worship are from you, and the giving of the houris, the palaces and the delights in Paradise is from Me, by His saying, Most High: "is the reward of goodness anything but goodness?"
6:s13.tr: Tâat ve ibadet sizden, cennette hûrileri, köşkleri ve nimetleri vermek bendendir; Allah Teâlâ'nın "İyiliğin karşılığı iyilikten başka mıdır?" sözüyle.

6:s14.en: And one repentance for the sins you committed in seventy years is from you, and acceptance is from Me.
6:s14.tr: Yetmiş yılda işlediğiniz günahlara bir kez tevbe sizden, kabul bendendir.

6:s15.en: By His saying, Most High: "He it is who accepts repentance from His servants."
6:s15.tr: Allah Teâlâ'nın "Kullarının tevbesini kabul eden O'dur" sözüyle.

6:s16.en: His saying, Most High: O My servants, your father Adam went against My command and disobeyed Me once, and I did not accept his repentance until after he had wept two hundred years.
6:s16.tr: Allah Teâlâ'nın sözü: Ey kullarım, babanız Âdem bir kez emrime aykırı davranıp bana isyan etti; iki yüz yıl ağladıktan sonra ancak tevbesini kabul ettim.

6:s17.en: Yet for your excuse over your disobedience of seventy years I accept your repentance and pardon your evil deeds.
6:s17.tr: Sizin ise yetmiş yıllık isyanınıza özrünüzle tevbenizi kabul eder, kötülüklerinizi affederim.

6:s18.en: For if I did not pardon the sins of the disobedient, My mercy would be idle.
6:s18.tr: Çünkü âsîlerin günahlarını affetmeseydim rahmetim atıl kalırdı.

6:s19.en: And if My creation were in any way deficient, My power would not be complete; and if I did not answer whoever calls on Me, My sovereignty would not be complete.
6:s19.tr: Yaratmam bir şeyde noksan olsaydı kudretim tamam olmazdı; bana duâ edene icâbet etmeseydim saltanatım tamam olmazdı.

7:s1.en: The second of them is that the servant be a disciple, by His saying, Most High: "ask the people of the Remembrance if you do not know."
7:s1.tr: İkincisi kulun mürîd olmasıdır; Allah Teâlâ'nın "Bilmiyorsanız zikir ehline sorun" sözüyle.

7:s3.en: The first: the absolute disciple, who never says "why?" to his shaykh and never brings an argument against him.
7:s3.tr: Birincisi: mutlak mürîd; şeyhine "niçin?" demeyen ve ona karşı delil getirmeyen kimsedir.

7:s4.en: The second: the disciple in name, who outwardly is at his shaykh's command but inwardly under the rule of his own self.
7:s4.tr: İkincisi: mecâzî mürîd; zâhirde şeyhinin emrinde, bâtında kendi nefsinin hükmünde olan kimsedir.

7:s5.en: The third: the pretending disciple, who, when he sees from his shaykh a state he dislikes, leaves him so as to go against him according to the demands of his own self, out of his lack of knowledge.
7:s5.tr: Üçüncüsü: riyakâr mürîd; şeyhinden bir hâl görünce, bilgisizliği yüzünden nefsinin isteğine göre ona aykırı gitmek için onu terk eden kimsedir.

7:s6.en: The third of them is shaving the head, changing one's dress to the dress of the people of the path and making oneself like them, by His saying, Most High: "with your heads shaved and your hair shortened, fearing not."
7:s6.tr: Üçüncüsü başı tıraş etmek, elbiseyi tarîkat ehlinin elbisesine çevirmek ve kendini onlara benzetmektir; Allah Teâlâ'nın "Başlarınızı tıraş etmiş ve kısaltmış olarak, korkmadan" sözüyle.

7:s7.en: And by his saying, peace be upon him: whoever imitates a people becomes one of them.
7:s7.tr: Ve Peygamber aleyhisselâmın "Bir kavme benzeyen onlardan olur" sözüyle.

7:s8.en: The fourth of them is that the servant be between fear and hope, by His saying, Most High: "they fear a day on which hearts and eyes will be turned about."
7:s8.tr: Dördüncüsü kulun havf ile recâ arasında olmasıdır; Allah Teâlâ'nın "Kalplerin ve gözlerin döneceği bir günden korkarlar" sözüyle.

7:s9.en: And by His saying, Most High: "do not despair of the mercy of God."
7:s9.tr: Ve Allah Teâlâ'nın "Allah'ın rahmetinden ümit kesmeyin" sözüyle.

7:s10.en: The fifth of them is service, by his saying, peace be upon him: whoever serves is served.
7:s10.tr: Beşincisi hizmettir; Peygamber aleyhisselâmın "Hizmet eden hizmet görür" sözüyle.

8:s1.en: The sixth of them is subduing the self, by his saying, peace be upon him: and strive against your selves.
8:s1.tr: Altıncısı nefsi kahretmektir; Peygamber aleyhisselâmın "Nefislerinize karşı cihâd edin" sözüyle.

8:s2.en: The seventh of them is returning to God Most High and leaving all besides Him, by His saying, Most High: "so flee to God."
8:s2.tr: Yedincisi Allah Teâlâ'ya dönmek ve O'ndan başkasını terk etmektir; Allah Teâlâ'nın "Allah'a kaçın" sözüyle.

8:s3.en: The eighth of them is the cloak, the scissors, the basket, the prayer rug, the licence, the lesson and the guidance; they are given from the Merciful to every servant according to his measure, by His saying, Most High: "God attains His purpose; God has set a measure for everything."
8:s3.tr: Sekizincisi hırka, makas, zenbil, seccâde, icâzet, ibret ve hidâyettir; bunlar Rahmân tarafından her kula kendi ölçüsünce verilir; Allah Teâlâ'nın "Allah emrini yerine getirendir; Allah her şey için bir ölçü koymuştur" sözüyle.

8:s4.en: The ninth of them is that he be a companion of the community and a man of love for the servants of God Most High, by His saying, Most High: "they love them as they love God, but those who believe are stronger in love for God."
8:s4.tr: Dokuzuncusu cemâat sahibi ve Allah Teâlâ'nın kullarına muhabbet sahibi olmaktır; Allah Teâlâ'nın "Onları Allah'ı sever gibi severler; îman edenlerin Allah'a sevgisi ise daha güçlüdür" sözüyle.

8:s5.en: The tenth of them is passionate love, longing, poverty and contentment, by His saying, Most High: "take me as a Muslim and join me with the righteous."
8:s5.tr: Onuncusu aşk, şevk, fakr ve kanaattir; Allah Teâlâ'nın "Beni müslüman olarak öldür ve beni sâlihlere kat" sözüyle.

8:s6.en: And he said, peace be upon him: passionate love is, of all being, the life and the core.
8:s6.tr: Ve Peygamber aleyhisselâm buyurdu: Aşk, varlığın hayatı ve özüdür.

8:s7.en: And he said, peace be upon him: poverty is my pride, and in it I will glory on the Day of Resurrection.
8:s7.tr: Ve Peygamber aleyhisselâm buyurdu: Fakirlik benim övüncümdür; kıyâmet günü onunla iftihar ederim.

9:s1.en: As for the ten stations that are in Ma'rifa:

9:s2.en: The first of them is manners, for none who arrived arrived except by reverence and manners, and none was deprived except by abandoning reverence and manners — by the saying of Ali, may God honour his face and be pleased with him: there is no nobility in wealth and lineage; nobility is in knowledge and manners.
9:s2.tr: Birincisi edebdir; çünkü vâsıl olan ancak hürmet ve âdâb ile vâsıl olmuş, mahrum kalan ancak hürmeti ve âdâbı terk ile mahrum kalmıştır — Ali'nin (Allah yüzünü ak etsin ve ondan râzı olsun) şu sözüyle: Şeref mal ve nesepte değildir; şeref ilim ve âdâbdadır.

9:s3.en: The Prophet said: manners are the form of the intellect.

9:s4.en: The second of them is fear, for the perfection of fear is in one who is learned of God and knows God, by His saying, Most High: "only the learned among His servants fear God."
9:s4.tr: İkincisi havftır; çünkü korkunun kemâli Allah'ı bilen ve Allah'ı tanıyan kimsededir; Allah Teâlâ'nın "Kulları içinde Allah'tan ancak âlimler korkar" sözüyle.

9:s5.en: And by His saying, Most High: "for him who fears the standing before his Lord there are two gardens."
9:s5.tr: Ve Allah Teâlâ'nın "Rabbinin huzurunda durmaktan korkan kimseye iki cennet vardır" sözüyle.

9:s6.en: The third of them is discipline, hunger and contentment, by his saying, peace be upon him: the likeness of hunger is the likeness of thunder, and the likeness of contentment is the likeness of the cloud, for thunder and cloud are the cause of rain.
9:s6.tr: Üçüncüsü riyâzet, açlık ve kanaattir; Peygamber aleyhisselâmın şu sözüyle: Açlığın misâli gök gürültüsünün misâli, kanaatin misâli bulutun misâlidir; çünkü gök gürültüsü ve bulut yağmurun sebebidir.

9:s7.en: And contentment and hunger are a cause of wisdom and knowledge.
9:s7.tr: Kanaat ve açlık da hikmet ve ma'rifetin sebebidir.

10:s1.en: The fourth of them is affirmation and assent, by His saying, Most High: "a day on which the truthful will profit from their truthfulness."
10:s1.tr: Dördüncüsü ikrar ve tasdiktir; Allah Teâlâ'nın "Bu, doğrulara doğruluklarının fayda vereceği gündür" sözüyle.

10:s2.en: The fifth of them is modesty, as the Prophet, peace be upon him, said: modesty is part of faith, and whoever has no modesty has no faith.
10:s2.tr: Beşincisi hayâdır; Peygamber aleyhisselâmın buyurduğu gibi: Hayâ îmandandır; hayâsı olmayanın îmanı yoktur.

10:s3.en: The sixth of them is generosity.

10:s4.en: The seventh of them is knowledge, as the Prophet, peace be upon him, said: the endurance of the world rests on four — the knowledge of the learned, the justice of the rulers, the generosity of the generous and the prayer of the poor.
10:s4.tr: Yedincisi ilimdir; Peygamber aleyhisselâmın buyurduğu gibi: Dünyanın bekāsı dört şeyledir — âlimlerin ilmi, emîrlerin adâleti, cömertlerin cömertliği ve fakirlerin duâsı.

10:s5.en: And he said, peace be upon him: generosity is a tree in Paradise whose branches hang down into this world; whoever takes hold of one of them, it leads him to Paradise.
10:s5.tr: Ve Peygamber aleyhisselâm buyurdu: Cömertlik cennette bir ağaçtır, dalları dünyaya sarkmıştır; kim onlardan birine tutunursa onu cennete götürür.

10:s6.en: The eighth of them is lowliness, as he said, peace be upon him: O God, make me poor and raise me among the company of the poor.
10:s6.tr: Sekizincisi meskenettir; Peygamber aleyhisselâmın buyurduğu gibi: Allah'ım, beni miskin kıl ve beni miskinler zümresiyle haşret.

10:s7.en: The ninth of them is caring for the heart and its contentment, as the Prophet, God bless him and grant him peace, said: the heart of the believer is the throne of God.
10:s7.tr: Dokuzuncusu kalbi gözetmek ve onun rızâsıdır; Peygamber sallallâhu aleyhi ve sellemin buyurduğu gibi: Müminin kalbi Allah'ın arşıdır.

10:s8.en: The tenth of them is knowing oneself, as the Prophet, God bless him and grant him peace, said: whoever knows himself knows his Lord.
10:s8.tr: Onuncusu nefsini bilmektir; Peygamber sallallâhu aleyhi ve sellemin buyurduğu gibi: Nefsini bilen Rabbini bilir.

11:s1.en: As for the ten stations that are in Haqiqa:

11:s2.en: The first of them is that the servant be among created beings like dust, not hurt by anyone's harm; rather he knows that whatever befalls him is from God Most High, is content with what strikes him of the kinds of affliction, entrusts his will to God Most High, and knows that the will and the wish belong to God Most High.
11:s2.tr: Birincisi kulun mahlûkât arasında toprak gibi olması, kimsenin eziyetinden incinmemesidir; bilakis başına gelen her şeyin Allah Teâlâ'dan olduğunu bilir, isabet eden musibetlere râzı olur, irâdesini Allah Teâlâ'ya havale eder ve irâde ile meşîetin Allah Teâlâ'ya ait olduğunu bilir.

11:s3.en: For God does what He wills and decrees what He wishes.
11:s3.tr: Çünkü Allah dilediğini yapar ve irâde ettiğine hükmeder.

11:s4.en: The second of them is that he look upon all created beings with a single gaze and not say "this one's deed is good" and "this one's deed is evil"; rather he looks for the good and the evil in himself.
11:s4.tr: İkincisi bütün mahlûkâta tek bir nazarla bakması, "bunun ameli hayır, şunun ameli şer" dememesi; hayrı ve şerri kendi nefsinde aramasıdır.

11:s5.en: For no one is punished for another, nor rewarded, by His saying, Most High: "to us our deeds and to you your deeds."
11:s5.tr: Çünkü kimse başkası için ne azap görür ne sevap alır; Allah Teâlâ'nın "Bizim amellerimiz bize, sizin amelleriniz size" sözüyle.

11:s6.en: The third of them is that he not withhold what God has provided him of food and clothing; rather he spends it in the way of God Most High, seeking His pleasure, by His saying, Most High: "the likeness of those who spend their wealth in the way of God."
11:s6.tr: Üçüncüsü Allah'ın kendisine verdiği yiyecek ve giyeceği esirgememesi, bilakis rızâsını dileyerek Allah Teâlâ yolunda harcamasıdır; Allah Teâlâ'nın "Mallarını Allah yolunda harcayanların misâli" sözüyle.

12:s1.en: The fourth of them is that the servant pass away from himself before his death, and by His saying, Most High: "what is with you passes away, and what is with God remains."
12:s1.tr: Dördüncüsü kulun ölümünden önce nefsinden fânî olmasıdır; ve Allah Teâlâ'nın "Sizin yanınızdaki tükenir, Allah'ın yanındaki ise bâkîdir" sözüyle.

12:s2.en: The fifth of them is that he harm none of the creatures, that he not be hurt by them nor they hurt by him, as the Prophet, God bless him and grant him peace, said: the Muslim is he from whose tongue and hand people are safe.
12:s2.tr: Beşincisi mahlûkâttan hiçbirine zarar vermemesi, ne onlardan incinmesi ne de onların ondan incinmesidir; Peygamber sallallâhu aleyhi ve sellemin buyurduğu gibi: Müslüman, insanların dilinden ve elinden selâmette olduğu kimsedir.

12:s3.en: The sixth of them is that the servant speak the words of the realities in love, and follow the perfect guide with complete will, as the Prophet, God bless him and grant him peace, said: the shaykh among his people is like the prophet among his community.
12:s3.tr: Altıncısı kulun muhabbetle hakîkat sözlerini söylemesi ve tam bir irâdeyle kâmil mürşide uymasıdır; Peygamber sallallâhu aleyhi ve sellemin buyurduğu gibi: Şeyh kavmi içinde, ümmeti içindeki peygamber gibidir.

12:s4.en: The seventh of them is the journey and the wayfaring on the way of the righteous, by His saying, Most High: "We shall show them Our signs on the horizons and within themselves."
12:s4.tr: Yedincisi seyr ve ebrârın yolunda sülûktur; Allah Teâlâ'nın "Onlara âyetlerimizi ufuklarda ve kendi nefislerinde göstereceğiz" sözüyle.

12:s5.en: The eighth of them is that the servant hide whatever miracles issue from him, by His saying, Most High: "say: whether you hide what is in your breasts or reveal it, God knows it."
12:s5.tr: Sekizincisi kulun kendisinden sâdır olan kerâmetleri gizlemesidir; Allah Teâlâ'nın "De ki: Göğüslerinizdekini gizleseniz de açığa vursanız da Allah onu bilir" sözüyle.

12:s6.en: The ninth of them is patience, connection, unity and intimate converse, by His saying, Most High: "O you who believe, be patient, vie in patience, stand guard, and fear God, that you may prosper."
12:s6.tr: Dokuzuncusu sabır, sıla, tevhid ve münâcâttır; Allah Teâlâ'nın "Ey îman edenler, sabredin, sabırda yarışın, nöbet tutun ve Allah'tan korkun ki kurtuluşa eresiniz" sözüyle.

12:s7.en: The tenth of them is witnessing with the inner eye and learning the knowledge of the Near One, by His saying, Most High: "and We taught him knowledge from Our presence."
12:s7.tr: Onuncusu bâtın gözüyle müşâhede ve ledün ilmini öğrenmektir; Allah Teâlâ'nın "Ona katımızdan bir ilim öğrettik" sözüyle.

13:s1.en: If even one of the forty stations were lacking, the wayfaring would not be complete and he would not reach the Truth.
13:s1.tr: Kırk makāmdan biri bile eksik olsa sülûk tamam olmaz ve Hakk'a ulaşılmaz.

13:s2.en: Because its conditions would be deficient.

13:s3.en: For example: whoever affirms the oneness of God Most High with his tongue but does not assent to it with his heart, his faith is not complete.
13:s3.tr: Meselâ: Allah Teâlâ'nın birliğini diliyle ikrar edip kalbiyle tasdik etmeyenin îmanı tamam olmaz.

13:s4.en: And so with the other conditions.

13:s5.en: Because the absence of the condition entails the absence of the conditioned.
13:s5.tr: Çünkü şartın yokluğu meşrûtun yokluğunu gerektirir.

13:s6.en: And God knows best what is right.

13:s7.en: The book called "al-Maqamat", by Imam Birgivi, God have abundant mercy on him, is complete.
13:s7.tr: İmam Birgivî'nin — Allah ona geniş rahmetiyle rahmet etsin — "Makāmāt" adlı kitabı tamam oldu.
